entities.summary: György "G. G." Golomán is a Hungarian professional basketball player for Hiopos Lleida of the Liga ACB. He played college basketball for the UCLA Bruins. Golomán went undrafted in the 2018 NBA draft. He started his career with Egis Körmend.
